mem.10:
27 Mar 2023: Audrey and Andrew caught up; Andrew had started a Financial Analyst job the week before. Audrey had dogs for three years and shared a photo of two wearing new collars. Her dogs: Pepper, Precious, Panda (later also Pixie); she adores them and takes them to parks and trails. Andrew has no pet, loves animals and is fascinated by eagles; shared birds silhouetted against sun. He spots birds hiking but hasn’t bird-watched. Recommended Fox Hollow; Audrey planned to try it.

2 Apr: Audrey’s household adopted Pixie, a small white puppy; she took a few days to adjust, then bonded with Pepper. Audrey shared dog photos. She hadn’t visited Fox Hollow due to puppy care. Andrew considered adopting but struggled to find pet-friendly city housing; Audrey suggested housing-site pet filters. He missed hiking with his family’s dog and shared trail photos. Audrey hoped to hike with her dogs; Andrew would update her about housing.

16 Apr: Andrew and girlfriend tried a city cafe; he liked it but missed nature/hiking. Nature makes him feel connected, at home in his soul, and helps him reset. Audrey said dog walks ground and recharge her. They enjoy city food spots; shared bakery treats/coffee and blueberry muffins, and planned a pastry party with dogs. Audrey shared dogs running, plus her dog-and-sunflowers tattoo: love of pups/nature and a way to see their faces when away; also shared dog-walking-in-woods photo.

3 May: Audrey hiked and saw a hummingbird (photo perched on branch, wings spread). Andrew found nearby open space and tries to hike weekly; shared sunset over lake and mountains. Nature is therapeutic, peaceful, invigorating; he likes capturing special moments. Audrey shared dogs in field/playing. Dogs love hikes, scents, nature; she prioritizes safety (shoes, leash), plays fetch with balls/frisbees, visits dog parks/playdates. Energetic, toy-loving dogs wear party hats for fun/treats. Recommended a wooded dog park with benches (photo dog jumping through ring); Andrew would visit.

5–6 May: Andrew searched for a dog via websites, shelters, friends; fun but frustrating (shared dog peering through cage). Audrey shared dogs running in field, one with ball. Andrew advised matching breed exercise needs to space; a smaller dog might suit his apartment. Pet-friendly housing still hard; contacting landlords, seeking area near park/woods. 5 May Audrey took dogs on a road trip to a national park (photo three running in grass); they do this every couple months. Andrew added furry-companion road trip to bucket list.

11 May: Andrew hiked with friends and girlfriend; shared path to grassy hill. Audrey had four dogs and signed up for positive-reinforcement bonding/training workshop next month after seeing flyer at pet store and meeting volunteer’s friendly dog. She believes in rewards, not punishment; hurting dogs pains her. Andrew agreed and asked for tips/update.

2 Jun: Audrey took pups to park, ran/played off leash; joyful and peaceful. Andrew shared mountain sunset with grazing horse. Audrey said she’d hiked with dogs at national park previous week, reached peak at sunset; breeze, birdsong and dogs felt like paradise. Shared favorite photo described as two horses in fenced field despite hike context. Nature cheers her and inspires gratitude. Andrew discouraged but persistent over housing; Audrey offered to search if he emailed criteria.

13 Jun: Andrew took rock-climbing class with friends Sunday, reached top, loved it, planned weekly outdoor activities. Shared summit view and man on rock face. Newbie found it tricky; friends’ cheering helped, felt proud. Interested in kayaking, perhaps bungee jumping; nature gets him outside comfort zone. Audrey found wooded small park trail, invited him and dogs; he accepted. Dogs enjoy people. Walks usually ~hour, varying at dogs’ pace; they return happy/tired. Dogs/nature are her happy place; outdoors brings joy, peace, inspiration. Andrew agrees it calms, inspires, refreshes.

26 Jun: Audrey moved to place with bigger backyard (photo two dogs on lawn); set up agility equipment/toys. Andrew shared dogs playing at nearby indoor doggy daycare; Audrey might check it out; he offered help finding dog-friendly places. Both see pets as family; Audrey can’t understand people who hate/hurt pets. Andrew shared flower bed in neighborhood park. Audrey unpacking. Andrew hiked with friends previous Friday, enjoyed birdsong/tree smell, hadn’t reviewed photos; missed nature’s peace. Audrey shared photo of feet on rock overlooking lake and recalled a memorable lake hike with friends years ago, sitting/chatting; shared person sitting on rock by lake. It soothed her; both valued small things and not taking life for granted.

3 Jul 2023: Audrey was taking dog-training course; challenging but rewarding, dogs improving, consuming time and limiting new trails. Andrew still couldn’t find dog-friendly rental, said life had thrown curveballs; doing urban adventures and finding hobbies while unable to hike. Audrey shared dogs running with ball; all are mutts, two Jack Russell mixes, two Chihuahua mixes; love running/fetch. Dog-bed photo. All four are 3 years old and a great pack; playdate previous Friday was crazy but fun; couch/blanket photo. Audrey called them her universe.

Andrew was getting into cooking/trying recipes. Audrey loves cooking as creative escape and stress relief; favorite is chicken pot pie, family recipe passed down for years, reminds her of grandma’s kitchen and table conversations. Shared pie photos, including lattice crust; offered recipe. Both find cooking relaxing/creative and enjoy eating afterward. Audrey likes music, a glass of wine, and improvising in kitchen; calls cooking self-care/therapeutic. Shared vegetable-heavy plate. Garlic is her go-to ingredient. Favorite garlic dish: roasted chicken, based on Mediterranean flavors; chicken, garlic, lemon, herbs, healthy/easy, her comfort meal. Shared chicken-and-potatoes pan photo and offered recipe; Andrew planned to try both recipes and report back. Conversation ended with friendly goodbyes.
mem.19:
Andrew became a Financial Analyst during the week of March 20, 2023. He lives in the city and loves animals but initially had no pet. Nature, hiking, greenery, mountain views and fresh air calm and restore him; he tries to hike outside the city on weekends and likes photographing nature to share its peacefulness. Fox Hollow is a favorite trail. He enjoys hiking most, and has also tried rock climbing (June 11, 2023; beginner, friends encouraged him, reached the top and loved the view), and considered kayaking and bungee jumping. He and his girlfriend enjoy exploring cafés and restaurants; on the weekend of April 8–9, 2023, they tried a café with croissants, muffins and tarts. They picnicked July 7 and volunteered at a pet shelter July 24, 2023. Andrew also went fishing with his girlfriend August 19–20 and visited a farm for fresh vegetables August 16. Work stress sometimes kept him indoors; in September he added morning coffee and lunch walks as self-care. He cooks to unwind and experiment, though considers himself a beginner.

Andrew wanted a dog but struggled to find pet-friendly housing. He searched websites, shelters and through friends, sought a smaller dog for an apartment, and wanted a home near a park or woods. Audrey offered to help find housing (June 2, 2023); Andrew intended to try positive-reinforcement training. On July 11, 2023, he brought home Toby, a male German Shepherd puppy, and shared photos. He hoped to bond with Toby and hike together, though Toby was too young for hikes in September. Audrey advised that puppies need time, attention, walks and activity, and that bonding should not be rushed. Andrew has wanted to learn grooming but lacked time. He takes care of flowers on his balcony. Andrew’s girlfriend is often his companion on outings.

Audrey has four dogs: Pepper, Precious, Panda and Pixie. She initially had Pepper, Precious and Panda; household adopted Pixie on April 2, 2023, a small white puppy. All four are three-year-old mixed breeds (two Jack Russell mixes, two Chihuahua mixes) as of July 3. Pepper initially needed time to adjust to Pixie; now the dogs get along and play together. Audrey described their distinct personalities July 27: oldest relaxed and sage-like, second playful, third sometimes naughty but cuddly, youngest lively and adventurous. Their favorite resting places: Pepper couch, Pixie bed, Precious chair, Panda rug; they cuddle together for naps. Audrey says they mean everything to her and bring joy. She has had them since around 2020, and had new collars/tags in March 2023. She makes wooden personalized name tags. She has tattoos of a dog and sunflowers (representing dogs and nature) and, by August 16, a tattoo depicting all four dogs. Max was Audrey’s energetic childhood dog who loved fetch; neighborhood walks and sharing her worries with him are cherished memories.

Audrey often walks her dogs, sometimes multiple times daily and usually about an hour, letting them explore; walks are their favorite and her happy place. She takes them hiking and on road trips (about every couple of months); May 5, 2023, they visited a national park, and in late May she hiked with them to a peak and enjoyed sunset, breeze and birdsong. She once found a beautiful mountain lake on a hike with friends. She enjoys watching her dogs run and play; they like fetch, frisbees, scents, nature and meeting dogs at park playdates. She has used leashes and shoes for safety, and dogs tolerate party hats for treats. She recommends the wooded dog park by her usual park, with trees and benches. She moved to a new home with a bigger backyard by June 26, 2023, and set up agility equipment and toys. She takes her dogs to agility classes twice weekly (August 2023). Audrey trains with positive reinforcement, patience and praise; teaches sit, stay, shake and roll over; rejects punishment. She took a challenging dog-training course in 2023 and attended a positive-reinforcement workshop planned for June. She learned grooming in August, including gentle care around ears and paws; recommends brushing, baths and nail trims. She once took all four to the vet at once and found it chaotic. On September 22, 2023, a dog pulled until its leash broke at a park; Audrey caught and soothed the dog unharmed with hugs, petting, calm words and a slow walk. Her dogs mostly play with one another in her garden.

Audrey loves nature and cooking as calming self-care; favorite recipe is family chicken pot pie, reminiscent of her grandmother. She likes garlic; favorite garlic dish is Mediterranean-inspired roasted chicken with lemon and herbs, and offered Andrew both recipes. She enjoys music and wine while cooking. She has a flower-and-vegetable garden; on September 24, 2023, flowers and vegetables were doing well. Flowers were Peruvian Lilies, brightly colored with delicate petals, needing water and sunlight. Audrey also walks neighbors’ dogs at playdates. Her dogs have supported her through hard times. She once saw a hummingbird while hiking (week of April 24–30). On August 24, she said she had never fished but enjoys lakes. She takes time for daily self-care.

Andrew and Audrey planned an August 2023 hike together with Audrey’s dogs; Andrew shared a trail map and they wanted a safe place where dogs could run. On July 11, Andrew invited Audrey and her dogs to hike with him and Toby; she accepted, and both looked forward to the dogs meeting. No specific date/location was settled. Other shared photos included Audrey’s dogs outdoors, a dog being groomed, and Andrew’s hiking views.
